_comment: TinyStories-Instruct-28M (GPT-Neo), the planned deployment model. Overlays model.json for analysis/roofline.py --model; dtypes, quant scales and tiles come from model.json. Dims are derived from workloads/results/flops/gpt_neo.csv and reproduce the published 51,987,968 parameters with tied embeddings. n_head is an assumption (TinyStories' Hugging Face configs use 16 heads); the FLOP counts don't pin it down.

assumed.n_head: 16 (d_head 32), from TinyStories' Hugging Face configs; not in the repo

sim_jobs._comment: Sim job names this model's estimate reads (measured in attention_vme_test and pointwise_test).
